inlines.v: CHOCOLATE, noun 1. A paste or cake composed of the kernel of cacao, with other ingredients, usually a little sugar, cinnamon or vanilla. The nut is first ground fine, mixed with the ingredients, and put in a mold. 2. The liquor made by dissolving chocolate in boiling water.
